scope: Four standard/compatibility mobile/desktop display templates applied by production GeckoPolicyAdapter; controller applied/observed acknowledgement on actual local JS contexts and document/script/page-fetch headers. Worker fetch headers are checked against independent GeckoSession.getDefaultUserAgent build evidence; desktop mismatch is retained, not aligned or rewritten. Full desktop HTTP UA consistency, real ChatGPT, process isolation, restart and experimental RFP remain unaccepted.

userAgentCapability.description: Session UA is observed in main/frame/Dedicated Worker JavaScript and document/script/page-fetch headers. Dedicated HTTP and Blob Worker fetch headers are checked against the independent SDK build mobile default; desktop session UA consistency for these requests is unsupported. The static default getter is not a native runtime acknowledgement.
